Weave and CareCredit Go Live with Integration That Places Patient Financing Inside the Front-Office Workflow
LEHI, Utah, October 12, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Weave (NYSE: WEAV), a leading AI-powered patient communications and payments platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, today announced the live availability of its integration with CareCredit, a leading patient financing solution from Synchrony (NYSE: SYF). The integration gives front-office staff real-time visibility into a patient's financing options directly within Weave — bringing one of healthcare's hardest conversations forward, before the appointment begins.
For most patients, the question of how to pay comes last: after the exam, after the recommendation, often as a surprise at checkout. That timing has consequences. Out-of-pocket costs remain one of the most common reasons patients delay or decline treatment. By surfacing a patient's CareCredit status and available credit at the start of the visit, Weave replaces sticker shock with an informed conversation — and gives practices a way to solve cost alongside the patient rather than let it stand between them and care.
It's also the latest expression of Weave's single-system approach: financing no longer lives in a separate portal, but inside the workflow where the front office already works.
"Affordability is one of the defining challenges facing patients, and practices are navigating shrinking margins at the same time," said Marcus Bertilson, Chief Operating Officer at Weave. "By making CareCredit a native part of the front-office experience, we're giving practices the tools to meet patients where they are financially — and to move more care forward. When staff can see a patient's available credit before the appointment, cost stops being the obstacle and starts being part of the plan."
Key benefits of the integration include:
-
The financial conversation, moved up front. Staff can view a patient's CareCredit status and available credit directly within Weave — no switching between systems.
-
CareCredit helps broaden access to recommended treatment. Promotional financing options help more patients confidently move forward with the care they want or need.
-
Deeper payments adoption. 43% of recently surveyed Weave payments customers said they would use Weave's payment services exclusively once CareCredit is added.
-
A modern, mobile-first experience. Practices can initiate CareCredit payments in-office or via a text-to-pay link, and patients can apply for credit directly within Weave or on their own device — meeting patients where they already are.
"The Weave team has built a seamless experience for practices that want to offer CareCredit at the point of care," said Greg Pierce, SVP Network Solutions at Synchrony (CareCredit). "When financing options are visible earlier in the patient journey — at a moment when clearer options can make a real difference — practices can have more confident conversations, and more patients move forward with the treatment they need."

LEHI, Utah --(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Weave (NYSE: WEAV), a leading AI-powered patient engagement and payments platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, today announced a new authorized integration with Elation Health, a leading clinical platform for independent primary care. The integration reduces manual work and improves operational efficiency by connecting patient communication directly to the practice's electronic health record (EHR).

Independent and direct primary care practices often manage disconnected systems and manual processes that divert staff time from patient care. The Weave and Elation Health integration addresses that friction by automatically syncing patient and appointment data between the two platforms, creating a connected operational layer that automates communication across the patient journey.

Manual data entry remains a significant drain on practice staff. A recent Weave survey of dental practices found that 80% of staff spend at least 30 minutes a day on manual data entry, with more than a quarter losing two or more hours. The new integration can give that time back to primary care teams by eliminating manual CSV uploads and automatically syncing data between systems.

"Practices using Elation Health are focused on delivering personal, relationship-driven care, and that means their teams shouldn't be stuck managing software instead of patients. This integration can clear the way for staff to spend more of their time where it matters most," said Scott Chandler, VP of Strategic Partnerships at Weave.

With the integration, practices using both Weave and Elation Health can:

Automatically sync patient and appointment data between systems, removing the need for manual uploads.

Identify callers instantly with real-time Call Pop showing patient and appointment context.

Reduce no-shows with automated appointment reminders and two-way texting.

Write appointment confirmations back into Elation Health automatically.

Grow online reputation with automated review requests sent after completed appointments.

New Weave product enhancements, an omnichannel AI Receptionist, and Automated Insurance Capture

Weave (NYSE: WEAV), a leading AI-powered patient engagement and payments platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, today announced a new set of platform capabilities designed to further meet the security, scalability, and automation needs of its growing enterprise customer base. The updates span single sign-on desktop authentication, expanded AI Receptionist functionality, and automated digital insurance collection, continuing Weave's investment in a platform that is as intelligent as it is easy to use.

"Enterprise practices need a platform that scales with them, securely and intelligently," said Marcus Bertilson, Chief Operating Officer and Head of Product at Weave. "These updates reflect what we hear consistently from our larger customers: they want stronger security controls, more visibility into AI performance, and less manual work for their front-office teams. We're building Weave to handle all three, without adding complexity for practices or patients."

Deliver Smarter Patient Interactions with AI Receptionist

According to Weave's 2026 State of Healthcare Pulse Survey, 47% of dental practices are experiencing staffing shortages, and the pressure to do more with existing teams has never been greater. Weave has significantly expanded its AI Receptionist capabilities, giving practices more control, visibility and automation across both calls and texts. Practices can now configure AI behavior based on working hours and contact type, distinguish between new and existing patients, and define escalation paths when a staff handoff is needed. Text-based AI interactions flow directly into the Weave inbox, preserving conversation context and keeping staff working in the tool they already use daily. New analytics give practice owners a clear view of call-handling performance and business impact, so no patient interaction goes untracked.

Simplify Patient Intake from Anywhere

In that same survey, automation is a priority, with 51% of practices wanting automated insurance verification, and 40% expressing the same for eligibility checks — yet both remain largely manual. Weave now enables practices to collect insurance information remotely ahead of the appointment. The platform automatically runs eligibility reports and writes verified insurance data back to the patient chart in the practice management system, eliminating the need for patients to be present and reducing the manual data entry that consumes hours of front-office time each day.

“What I hear from DSO leaders consistently is that they need technology that meets enterprise security standards, reduces operational drag across locations, and integrates AI in a way that's seamless and compliant. The direction Weave is taking with these updates reflects a real understanding of what these groups actually need to scale,” said Brian A. Colao, Director of Dykema's Dental Service Organizations Industry Group.

For more information, visit https://www.getweave.com/weave-enterprise/

About Weave

Weave is a leading vertical SaaS company delivering an AI-powered patient engagement and payments platform purpose-built for modern healthcare practices. More than software, Weave is an always-on teammate—handling patient interactions across voice and text and operating at the center of the patient journey. Through agentic AI workflows and authorized integrations with practice management systems, Weave ensures critical tasks like scheduling, insurance verification, and payments happen seamlessly, so nothing falls between the cracks. By embedding AI directly into daily operations, Weave reduces administrative workload, frees up staff to focus on human-centered care, and delivers real-time insights that help practices run smarter and grow with confidence. Serving over 40,000 customer locations, Weave was named a 2026 Best Software Awards winner for healthcare software products by G2. To learn more, visit getweave.com/newsroom.

data.full_text: WeaveX Inc. (Headquarters: Shibuya, Tokyo, Representative Director: Ryo Toyazaki, hereinafter referred to as "WeaveX") will start providing its self-developed career design AI "LAife" and a team of experienced HR professionals, a human resources BPO service for small and venture companies called "LAife Align" (tentative name) from June 16, 2026. This service is a one-stop support model for small and growing companies that do not have the resources to hire dedicated HR strategic partners (HRBP), assisting from recruitment (requirement definition, document screening, interview support) to placement and development. HRBP is not a function needed only by large companies; rather, it plays a crucial role in supporting business growth for small and venture companies that are advancing recruitment, development, and organizational building with limited personnel. By combining ultra-fast data structuring by AI and professional insights (tacit knowledge from the field), we make it possible to implement advanced HR strategies, which were previously the privilege of large companies, in small and growing companies. Background: Intensifying recruitment market and the limits of "one-person HR" In the current situation, the importance of "investment in people (human capital management)" in companies has reached an all-time high due to the domestic labor shortage and the acceleration of reskilling policies. While large companies are rapidly advancing organizational redesign based on AI, small and venture companies, which need these benefits the most, are facing serious challenges such as the following. The limits of "one-person HR": A single person is responsible for recruitment, labor, and general affairs, and cannot manage HR strategies (HRBP functions) directly linked to management. Serious mismatches: Early departures are frequent due to "recruitment mismatches" arising from anxiety and lack of resources, leading to significant opportunity losses for companies and organizations, especially in key positions such as sales. To resolve the dilemma of "no resources but cannot compromise" faced by small ventures, we have launched a new co-pilot HR BPO service "LAife Align" (tentative name) that combines "AI productivity" and "professional field sense." Service Overview: "Next-generation HR co-pilot" realized by people (tacit knowledge) × AI (LAife) "LAife Align" (tentative name) is neither a service that sells SaaS nor a traditional task outsourcing BPO. It incorporates AI "LAife" into consulting/BPO support related to recruitment, placement, and development, enhancing the quality of our support while also allowing both companies and candidates to utilize it in some processes. Instead of providing AI as a separate product, we integrate it into the support process, fundamentally changing corporate HR decisions to be deeper and more reproducible, which is a decisive difference from traditional services. Our consultants and AI will formalize the "unarticulated requirements (tacit knowledge)" held by the management and field, while simultaneously structuring candidates' true feelings and thought processes as "line" data. By visualizing each other's tacit knowledge as data and organizing it as "company-specific HR assets" by our consultants, we eliminate discrepancies in recognition between management, HR, and the field, achieving the fastest possible organization building without mismatches. Specific support examples: Extraction of tacit knowledge: Our HR professionals and AI will interview to articulate the ideal candidate profile and challenges of the company. Structuring by AI: Candidates will use AI "LAife" to automatically profile values and thought processes from dialogue data. Organizing HR asset data: Extracted data will be analyzed by our consultants and delivered as "selection criteria and development plans that can be used on-site from tomorrow." Examples of outputs provided: Recruitment area: Phase-specific recruitment requirement definitions, document screening criteria based on data, interview support, 90-day onboarding plans. Placement and development area: Assignment proposals that match individual value data with business needs, individual growth themes, and mentor matching design. Competitive Advantage: "Ability to implement on-site" that cannot be imitated by generic AI tools We believe that a SaaS model that only provides tools cannot save the "on-site decision-making" of small companies. That is why WeaveX is thoroughly committed to "implementing on-site decision-making and practical workflows" that cannot be solved by AI alone. The value created by co-creation between people and AI, rather than differentiation of functions, is our greatest strength. Future Outlook: WeaveX aims to package the "successful model linking management, HR, and the field" created by this service into a unique AI product in the future, targeting horizontal expansion such as BPaaS. We aim to spread not just as a functional provider but as a new organizational development infrastructure that drives corporate growth autonomously. We will democratize advanced HR strategies (HRBP) for all companies towards the realization of our mission "to weave our own stories" and vision "a world where challenges are the norm." Comment from Representative Director Ryo Toyazaki: "HR is caught in the middle when the opinions of management and the field diverge. Candidates are judged solely by their resumes and do not get to show their true worth. I have seen such 'discrepancies where no one is happy' far too often in my previous job. That is why we want to use cutting-edge technology like AI to eliminate such 'misalignments between people and organizations.' The 'line' data woven from dialogue by AI will become a common language connecting management, HR, the field, and candidates. Small ventures can create strong organizations that do not lose to large companies, in a more human way than anywhere else—this is the world that our team will strive to realize together." About WeaveX Inc. Mission: To establish "weaving our own stories" as a permanent concept. Vision: To become a platformer of "a world where challenges are the norm." Weave’s latest Call Intelligence capabilities help healthcare practices engage patients before cost concerns take over
LEHI, Utah--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Weave (NYSE: WEAV), a leading AI-powered patient communications and engagement platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, today announced a series of platform enhancements to one of its leading AI products, Call Intelligence. The latest updates turn the product from a robust analytics tool into a deeply embedded, AI-driven workflow engine for modern healthcare practices.
Healthcare businesses don't just need more data — they need to prioritize follow-up without drowning in more overhead.
Share
The announcement comes at a pivotal moment for the healthcare industry. According to recent polling, two-thirds of Americans (66%) say they worry about affording health care, ranking it higher than anxiety about utilities, food, housing, and gas. More than half of adults (55%) report their healthcare costs have increased in the past year, and 56% expect those costs to become even less affordable in the year ahead. Against this backdrop, the window between a patient's intent to schedule and their decision to defer care is narrowing — and every missed call, incomplete conversation, or overlooked follow-up now carries a greater cost for practice owners.
"Healthcare businesses don't just need more data — they need to prioritize follow-up without drowning in more overhead. Call Intelligence turns everyday interactions into meaningful, measurable outcomes that capture revenue and maintain the human touch,” said Abhi Sharma, Chief Technology Officer at Weave. “The refined version of Call Intelligence acts as an indispensable teammate that allows front-desk teams to focus more on their patients. In an environment marked by rising costs, patient trust and communication are everything."
Behaving more like an educated staff member than software, Weave’s Call Intelligence:
- Prioritizes high-value and urgent follow-ups. Opportunity detection helps practices identify unscheduled patients and track which appointments were recovered after an initially unscheduled interaction — giving leaders a clearer picture of scheduling conversion and ROI.
- Integrates workflows directly with practice management systems (PMS). With select PMS writebacks, Call Intelligence connects AI-generated summaries directly to the practice's system of record — reducing manual data entry, improving documentation consistency, and making conversation insights easier to operationalize without leaving existing workflows.
- Includes enterprise and multi-location capabilities. The product now supports the needs of larger practices and multi-location organizations with semantic search across conversation transcripts, multi-location comparison views, aggregated reporting, granular filtering, data exportability, and role-based access controls.
- Covers expanded verticals in healthcare: Originally launched with a dental focus, Call Intelligence now serves a growing range of healthcare verticals — including veterinary, optometry, and medical specialties such as dermatology, surgery, primary care, mental health, and plastic surgery.
"Before Call Intelligence, we had very limited insight into call quality, missed opportunities, or consistency across staff. Now we can review real call data and identify patterns that were previously invisible — missed conversion opportunities, inconsistent scripting, or staff not feeling empowered to use the tools at their disposal,” said dermatologist and multi-location owner, Dr. Jeffrey Ellis. “The result has been improved consistency across the team, and stronger conversion of inbound inquiries into booked appointments."
